question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier, and well above the {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} low of mid-2024; the annual figure for 2025 was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} for 2024. Receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, also the highest of the six. The average-balance figure over the trailing four quarters is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The liquidity section of MD&A newly says that certain large customer arrangements include extended payment terms, yet the paragraph that explains the receivables increase cites only higher product and service billings; the cause named in one paragraph is absent from the other. Contract liabilities are moving with revenue, not against it: current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, second highest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a quarter earlier but up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a year earlier; the current balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year ago, and the total including the non-current portion is larger still. Revenue recognized from opening contract liabilities rose sharply year over year, so a growing share of each quarter's revenue is the release of earlier deferrals. The judgment area is acceptance: MD&A says new products, especially AI Ethernet, bring more customer trials and contracts with acceptance periods, which raise evaluation inventory and product deferred revenue and may make revenue vary by quarter and year. That is a new, substantive judgment area in revenue timing even though deferral itself is conservative. No principal-versus-agent, standalone-selling-price or bill-and-hold wording change is in the notes text. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested because the record has no fourth-quarter cells. Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter, and the 8-K release and the 10-Q print the same quarterly revenue.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Recognition is conservative in form, with large deferrals under acceptance terms, but receivables sit at a six-quarter high alongside newly disclosed extended payment terms; timing risk is rising.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release and the 10-Q agree on the figures they share: quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, quarterly net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, a GAAP gross margin that the release prints at the same value as the trend cell {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, and six-month operating cash flow. Where they differ is narrative. The release calls the quarter strong, broad-based growth; the 10-Q attributes the gross margin decline to a larger share of sales to large end customers who receive higher discounts, and attributes the Non-Americas share movement to the geographic mix of large global customers. The release's headline non-GAAP EPS growth is measured against a comparative recast upward under the new tax method, and the CFO quote does not say which EPS measure it cites. Of the notes items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm nearly all; the sales-and-marketing and general-and-administrative items are unresolved because those lines are not itemized in the numbers report, and the broad-based-growth item is contradicted by the margin explanation and the concentration facts.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Figures reconcile across documents; the two documents' descriptions of where growth came from do not.

anomalies.name: Quarterly operating cash flow fell while net income rose
anomalies.what: Net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} quarter over quarter and {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, while the quarter's operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}. MD&A explains only the six-month cash flow and gives no reason for the quarterly decline.

anomalies.name: Income is much smoother than cash
anomalies.what: The smoothness ratio is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, far below one: quarterly net income steps up steadily while quarterly operating cash flow swings widely. Nothing in the text addresses the quarterly cash volatility.

anomalies.name: Operating cash exceeds income because of deferred revenue
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, yet receivables, inventory and deferred costs all absorbed cash; the gap is filled by the deferred revenue inflow that MD&A ties to product shipped under acceptance terms. The cash arrives before the revenue is earned, so the excess is timing, not conservatism in earnings.

anomalies.name: Small payables articulation gap
anomalies.what: The balance-sheet change in payables of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} differs from the cash-flow statement's change by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}; receivables and inventory articulate exactly. The VeloCloud acquisition's assumed liabilities sit inside the window and could explain it, but the text does not say.

anomalies.name: Days sales outstanding at a six-quarter high
anomalies.what: Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a quarter earlier, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} two years earlier. The receivables explanation cites only higher billings.

anomalies.name_ko: 연장 지급조건 공시가 매출채권 설명에서는 빠짐
anomalies.what: The liquidity paragraph says large customer arrangements include extended payment terms that may create working-capital timing differences; the paragraph explaining the receivables increase of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, cites billings only. The numbers, with receivables over revenue at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, fit the extended-terms cause.

Revenue released from opening contract liabilities rose sharply. MD&A says trials and acceptance periods will make revenue vary by quarter and year.

anomalies.name: Allowance, inventory reserve and warranty reserve not in the tagged record
anomalies.what: No allowance for credit losses is tagged for any recent period (last filled in 2022 at {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}), and no inventory valuation reserve or warranty accrual is tagged in any period, so reserve thinning cannot be measured for a hardware company with rising inventory and receivables.

anomalies.name: Evaluation inventory rising sharply
anomalies.what: Finished goods held as evaluation inventory at customers rose sharply from year-end 2025 to June 2026; MD&A names trials and acceptance periods as the cause and warns of returns and write-downs if acceptance fails. The amount is not a calculator field.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate rose as equity-compensation benefits fell
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate}; the quarterly and six-month rates rose year over year. The text attributes it to a decrease in equity-compensation tax benefits. The move is against the company, not a release.

anomalies.name: Deferred costs and soft assets at their highest share
anomalies.what: Soft assets over total assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier; current deferred costs, prepaid and other current assets, deferred tax assets and other assets all rose from year-end. The prepaid footnote ties the deferred cost increase to deferred product revenue.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP tax method change raised prior-year comparatives
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 세금 방법 변경으로 전년 비교치 상향
anomalies.what: The release recast all prior non-GAAP results under a method adopted in the fourth quarter of 2025, which raised prior-year non-GAAP net income and six-month EPS; the headline year-over-year non-GAAP growth is measured against that lifted base. No non-GAAP gap ratio exists in the record.

anomalies.name: Intangible amortization add-back is recurring and larger
anomalies.what: The non-GAAP reconciliation adds back intangible amortization at a much larger amount than a year earlier following VeloCloud, alongside share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters; both recur every quarter.

anomalies.name: Off-balance-sheet purchase commitments rising
anomalies.what: Non-cancellable purchase commitments rose from year-end 2025 through March to June 2026 with nearly all due within twelve months, an amount larger than the trailing-four-quarter cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. Management says it increased commitments to respond to AI deployment and tightening memory and silicon supply.

anomalies.name: Purchase obligation scope sentence removed
anomalies.what: The sentence saying purchase obligations also cover software licences, property and corporate goods was removed from the note; the text does not say whether the stated amount now excludes them, so the March and June amounts may not be on the same basis.

anomalies.name: Deposits to contract manufacturers rising
anomalies.what: Deposits to secure purchase commitments rose at each of year-end 2025, March 2026 and June 2026; they are carried in prepaid and other assets, which also rose. The prose does not state the direction or the reason.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising with a large unamortized balance
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters and the quarterly expense rose year over year; the note quotes a large unamortized cost still to be recognized. It is a real cost already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}).

anomalies.name: Chief financial officer modified her trading plan

anomalies.what: A new disclosure that a director adopted a trading arrangement to sell shares through mid-2027. No number tests it.

anomalies.what: The release's headline non-GAAP EPS growth and the CFO's EPS-up remark are measured against a prior-year non-GAAP figure raised by the tax method change; the CFO quote does not say which EPS measure it cites. GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}.

anomalies.name: Reseller B revenue share rising
anomalies.what: Reseller B's share of annual revenue went from {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in 2023 to {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in 2024 and {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} in 2025, while Reseller A's went from {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.5.value|pct}. The 10-Q attributes the margin decline to large end customers with higher discounts.

anomalies.name: Trial inventory at customer sites rising while overall turns improve

MD&A names trials and acceptance periods as the cause.

anomalies.name: Strategic investments held, no customer link disclosed
anomalies.name_ko: 전략적 투자 보유, 고객 연계 공시 없음
anomalies.what: The release excludes gains on strategic investments from non-GAAP income, so the company invests in other companies; nothing in the notes text says whether any investee buys from the company. Circular dealing cannot be confirmed or ruled out from this record.
